# `Q-20-10` — Styled Raw HTML Table Not CSS-Inlined for Typst in the Browser

> A raw HTML table or `<pre>` block with a `<style>` element loses
> that styling in browser Typst output.

## What this means

Native Typst rendering moves the rules of a raw HTML block's `<style>`
element onto the elements they style. That step is not available in
the browser, so the Typst output may lose the styling. Native
`q2 render` is not affected.

## How to fix

Put the styling inline, as `style` attributes on the elements, or
render with `q2 render`.
